desc: Ideation: decompose p as A*B*C, prove fixed-start greedy (earliest B then earliest C), choose KMP + next-occurrence arrays for O(|s|+|p|)

Implement the complete solution: parse p into (a,b,c) around the two stars, use KMP to build occurrence flags for each literal (empty literal = all boundaries 0..n), build nextB/nextC arrays of size n+2 with INF sentinel via right-to-left scans, then enumerate feasible A-starts chaining j=nextB[i+len(a)], k=nextC[j+len(b)], minimizing k+len(c)-i; return -1 if no chain succeeds.

Verify against all four provided examples plus edge cases: p="**" (expect 0), leading/trailing/adjacent stars, overlapping occurrences, matches at string boundaries, no-match cases, and random small strings cross-checked against a brute-force enumerator.
